POD_set_province_size = {
	# set baseline to desired value with scaling modifier
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = province_size_delta
		value = {
			value = $SIZE$
			subtract = province_size_baseline
		}
	}
	remove_province_modifier = POD_province_size_baseline_modifier
	add_province_modifier    = POD_province_size_baseline_modifier
	
	# set province size to new baseline
	change_province_size_progress = {
		value    = province_size_baseline
		subtract = province_size
	}
}
